name: 06-short-fragment-merged
covers: Fragment under the threshold -> merged INTO THE PREVIOUS step
why: `Wait.` is a marker-initial sentence of one word. C4.2 2c splits it out and 2d merges it back; the pair of rules exists to keep the split points without creating one-word steps that poison per-class F1.

calls.reasoning:
The notebook and pen together cost two dollars and sixty cents in total, and the notebook costs two dollars more than the pen does.
Wait.
So if the pen is p then the notebook is p plus two, and the sum is two p plus two equals two dollars sixty.
